data.key: Sorcerer Bonus Spell L1 ~ Burning Hands
data.name: Burning Hands
data.description: A cone of searing flame shoots from your fingertips. Any creature in the area of the flames takes 1d4 points of fire damage per caster level [maximum 5d4]. Flammable materials burn if the flames touch them. A character can extinguish burning items as a full-round action.|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
